Each application shows one side of the work in this repository. Each part below names one, and ends with the command
that prints it.

## Flow

The whole trip of the work, from an issue to a release, one stage to a tab.

`kit flow`

## Issues

The work to do: the backlog, and the issues underway.

`kit flow backlog`

## Changes

The pull requests, each with its build.

`kit flow changes`

## Repositories

This repository, or each one in your workspace.

`kit workspace`

## Delivery

The releases, and the builds that made them.

`kit flow releases`

## Platform

What kit runs with here.

`kit platform`
